Anchor.description:
Where a block's text is written: the README's anchor grammar, the same
string the rendered page carries in `data-ascribe-source` and
`data-ascribe-via`.

source.description:
`<path>:<first>-<last>`: the file's content path, percent-encoded by
segment, and the block's first and last lines, from 1.

via.description:
The includes the block came through, outermost first, each
`<path>:<line>`. Empty for a block written in the page itself.

BaseInfo.description: The base of a comparison, in the report.

merge_base.description:
The merge base of that commit and `HEAD`, which the comparison reads;
`null` with `--base-exact`, which reads `commit`.

requested.description: The revision asked for, or the default branch used.

pages.description: Its changed pages, in path order.

after.description:
For a removed block, and a moved block's old place: the block of the
new version it came after, among its siblings. Absent when it was
first.

now.description: Where it's written now: every kind but `removed`.

parent.description:
For a removed block, and a moved block's old place: the block of the
new version it was inside. Absent at the top of the page.

text.description:
For a removed block, its text, whitespace collapsed, so it can be
shown where it was.

was.description: Where it was written: every kind but `added`.

words.description: For changed prose, the words that differ.

oneOf.description: The same block is somewhere else.

Counts.description: How many changes of each kind a page has.

added.description: Blocks only in the new version.

removed.description: Blocks only in the old version.

FormattedPiece.description:
A piece of a formatted value, as the JSON output writes it:
`{ "type": "text" | "code", "value": … }`. Other JSON that shows a
formatted title, such as the review report's, writes it the same way.

value.description: Its text: a code span's content without its backticks.

ImageRef.description: An image a page refers to.

bytes.description: Its size, when it's too large to include.

image.description: Its key in `images`, when it's included.

Limit.description: How many changed pages a report renders, and how many it left out.

PageData.description: One changed page: `ascribe diff --format json`'s, and its renderings.

because.description:
The other changed files the page's change can come from: fragments it
includes and pages its links take a title or a heading from, in path
order; then the snippets whose code changed, by address
(`code:app.py#main`); and `ascribe.toml` (last) when the content model
is a cause.

changes.description:
The block-level changes, in the page's order, a removed block where
it was. Empty for an added or removed page, and for every page when
the report's `blocks_omitted` is `true`.

counts.description: How many changes of each kind.

formatted_title.description:
Its title formatted, when its field sets `inline = "code"`: for the
page list and the page's heading. `title` stays the plain text.

now.description: The page now, as a key of `pages`; `null` when there's none.

omitted.description: Whether it's beyond the limit, so not rendered.

own_file_changed.description: Whether the page's own file changed (or exists on one side only).

page_changed.description:
What changed about the page itself besides its blocks, in this
order: `title`, `frontmatter`, `availability` (the page-level one),
and `route`. Empty for an added or removed page.

prompt.description:
The agent prompt about the page, which its Copy prompt button copies:
what `ascribe diff --format prompt` writes for it. Absent when the
report was written without prompts.

route.description: Its route: the new one, or for a removed page the old one.

status.description:
Whether the build publishes it only now, only before, or in both
with a difference.

title.description: Its title, when the build has one.

was.description: The page before, as a key of `pages`; `null` when there's none.

PageStatus.description: Whether a page is new, gone, or different.

oneOf.description: The build publishes it now, and didn't before.
The build published it before, and doesn't now.
The build publishes it in both, and it differs.

PieceKind.description: What a piece of a formatted value is.

RenderedPage.description: A page rendered: its HTML, and what each image reference in it is.

html.description: The page's content, rendered with source anchors.

images.description: Each image reference the HTML writes, and what it is.

Words.description:
The words that differ inside a changed block of prose. Ranges are
`[start, end)` in characters (Unicode scalar values) of each side's
`text`, which is the block's text with whitespace collapsed.

now.description: Ranges in `now_text`: words added or replacing others.

was.description: Ranges in `was_text`: words removed or replaced.

description:
The data the report's script draws from. Its keys, like the JSON
report's, are snake_case.

ascribe_version.description: The version of Ascribe that wrote it.

image_limit.description: The size, in bytes, above which an image isn't included.

images.description: Each image, as a `data:` URL, once however many pages use it.

limit.description: How many changed pages the report renders, and how many it left out.

pages.description: Each rendered page, once however many builds render it alike.

working_tree_errors.description: How many errors `ascribe check` finds in the working tree.

title: ReportData
